verses.text: Wisdom has built her house; she has carved out her seven pillars.

xrefs.text: And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

The one who overcomes I will make a pillar in the temple of My God, and he will never again leave it. Upon him I will write the name of My God, and the name of the city of My God (the new Jerusalem that comes down out of heaven from My God), and My new name.
you also, like living stones, are being built into a spiritual house to be a holy priesthood, offering spiritual sacrifices acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

And recognizing the grace that I had been given, James, Cephas, and John— those reputed to be pillars— gave me and Barnabas the right hand of fellowship, so that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcised.
For we are God’s fellow workers; you are God’s field, God’s building.

verses.text: She has prepared her meat and mixed her wine; she has also set her table.

xrefs.text: He sent his servants to call those he had invited to the banquet, but they refused to come.
On this mountain the LORD of Hosts will prepare a lavish banquet for all the peoples, a feast of aged wine, of choice meat, of finely aged wine.
But Jesus replied, “A certain man prepared a great banquet and invited many guests.
“Come, eat my bread and drink the wine I have mixed.
Those who linger over wine, who go to taste mixed drinks.

verses.text: She has sent out her maidservants; she calls out from the heights of the city.

xrefs.text: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the heights of the city,
Does not wisdom call out, and understanding raise her voice?
He sent his servants to call those he had invited to the banquet, but they refused to come.
The Lord gives the command; a great company of women proclaim it:
Wisdom calls out in the street, she lifts her voice in the square;

verses.text: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” she says to him who lacks judgment.

xrefs.text: He who commits adultery lacks judgment; whoever does so destroys himself.
O simple ones, learn to be shrewd; O fools, gain understanding.
At that time Jesus declared, “I praise You, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because You have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.
“Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” she says to him who lacks judgment.
“How long, O simple ones, will you love your simple ways? How long will scoffers delight in their scorn and fools hate knowledge?

verses.text: “Come, eat my bread and drink the wine I have mixed.

xrefs.text: Do not work for food that perishes, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on Him God the Father has placed His seal of approval.

I have come to my garden, my sister, my bride; I have gathered my myrrh with my spice. I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk. Eat, O friends, and drink; drink freely, O beloved.
“Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is tasty!”

They will come and shout for joy on the heights of Zion; they will be radiant over the bounty of the LORD— the grain, new wine, and oil, and the young of the flocks and herds. Their life will be like a well-watered garden, and never again will they languish.
While they were eating, Jesus took bread, spoke a blessing and broke it, and gave it to the disciples, saying, “Take and eat; this is My body.

verses.text: Leave your folly behind, and you will live; walk in the way of understanding.”

xrefs.text: He who walks with the wise will become wise, but the companion of fools will be destroyed.
I will guide you in the way of wisdom; I will lead you on straight paths.
“Make every effort to enter through the narrow door. For many, I tell you, will try to enter and will not be able.
“Therefore come out from among them and be separate, says the Lord. Touch no unclean thing, and I will receive you.”
Do not set foot on the path of the wicked or walk in the way of evildoers.

verses.text: He who corrects a mocker brings shame on himself; he who rebukes a wicked man taints himself.

xrefs.text: A mocker does not love to be reproved, nor will he consult the wise.
Do not speak to a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
But they mocked the messengers of God, despising His words and scoffing at His prophets, until the wrath of the LORD against His people was stirred up beyond remedy.
Therefore the anger of the LORD burned against Amaziah, and He sent him a prophet, who said, “Why have you sought this people’s gods, which could not deliver them from your hand?”

Then the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah son of Jehoiada the priest, who stood up before the people and said to them, “This is what God says: ‘Why do you transgress the commandments of the LORD so that you cannot prosper? Because you have forsaken the LORD, He has forsaken you.’”

verses.text: Do not rebuke a mocker, or he will hate you; rebuke a wise man, and he will love you.

xrefs.text: Poverty and shame come to him who ignores discipline, but whoever heeds correction is honored.
Let the righteous man strike me; let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion. It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it. For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.
Do not speak to a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.
A mocker does not love to be reproved, nor will he consult the wise.
Do not give dogs what is holy; do not throw your pearls before swine. If you do, they may trample them under their feet, and then turn and tear you to pieces.

verses.text: Instruct a wise man, and he will be wiser still; teach a righteous man, and he will increase his learning.

xrefs.text: let the wise listen and gain instruction, and the discerning acquire wise counsel
I have written these things to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, so that you may know that you have eternal life.
He replied, “The knowledge of the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.
Like an earring of gold or an ornament of fine gold is a wise man’s rebuke to a listening ear.
You, however, have an anointing from the Holy One, and all of you know the truth.

verses.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, and knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

xrefs.text: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
And He said to man, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom, and to turn away from evil is understanding.’”
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
When all has been heard, the conclusion of the matter is this: Fear God and keep His commandments, because this is the whole duty of man.
then you will discern the fear of the LORD and discover the knowledge of God.

verses.text: For through wisdom your days will be multiplied, and years will be added to your life.

xrefs.text: The fear of the LORD prolongs life, but the years of the wicked will be cut short.
for they will add length to your days, years and peace to your life.
Long life is in her right hand; in her left hand are riches and honor.

so that you and your children and grandchildren may fear the LORD your God all the days of your lives by keeping all His statutes and commandments that I give you, and so that your days may be prolonged.

verses.text: If you are wise, you are wise to your own advantage; but if you scoff, you alone will bear the consequences.

xrefs.text: “Can a man be of use to God? Can even a wise man benefit Him?
Most importantly, you must understand that in the last days scoffers will come, scoffing and following their own evil desires.

The soul who sins is the one who will die. A son will not bear the iniquity of his father, and a father will not bear the iniquity of his son. The righteousness of the righteous man will fall upon him, and the wickedness of the wicked man will fall upon him.
Reconcile now and be at peace with Him; thereby good will come to you.
A worker’s appetite works for him because his hunger drives him onward.

verses.text: The woman named Folly is loud; she is naive and knows nothing.

xrefs.text: She is loud and defiant; her feet do not remain at home.
She does not consider the path of life; she does not know that her ways are unstable.
Better to live in the desert than with a contentious and ill-tempered wife.
he is conceited and understands nothing. Instead, he has an unhealthy interest in controversies and disputes about words, out of which come envy, strife, abusive talk, evil suspicions,
Better to live on a corner of the roof than to share a house with a quarrelsome wife.

Then a woman came out to meet him, with the attire of a harlot and cunning of heart.

verses.text: calling out to those who pass by, who make their paths straight.

xrefs.text: Do not let your heart turn aside to her ways; do not stray into her paths.
For a prostitute is a deep pit, and an adulteress is a narrow well.
She seizes him and kisses him; she brazenly says to him:

verses.text: “Stolen water is sweet, and bread eaten in secret is tasty!”

xrefs.text: Food gained by fraud is sweet to a man, but later his mouth is full of gravel.
Do not gaze at wine while it is red, when it sparkles in the cup and goes down smoothly.
This is the way of an adulteress: She eats and wipes her mouth and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
But each one is tempted when by his own evil desires he is lured away and enticed.

When the woman saw that the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eyes, and that it was desirable for obtaining wisdom, she took the fruit and ate it. She also gave some to her husband who was with her, and he ate it.

verses.text: But they do not know that the dead are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

xrefs.text: Her house is the road to Sheol, descending to the chambers of death.
For her house sinks down to death, and her tracks to the departed spirits.
Her feet go down to death; her steps lead straight to Sheol.
The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but fools despise wisdom and discipline.
They do not know or understand; they wander in the darkness; all the foundations of the earth are shaken.
